description: Calibration test set for Micha Stocks semantic search
threshold: Each query maps to ground-truth patterns from the KB. Used to find the confidence gate where false positives = 0.

tests.query: Is this stock too expensive to buy right now?
tests.notes: Patterns about valuation logic — high PE, checking sentiment

tests.query: My stock dropped 15%, should I sell it?
tests.notes: Stop loss rules, thesis re-evaluation

tests.query: There's a big crash happening, should I buy the dip?
tests.notes: Dip buying rules — wait for stabilization, don't catch falling knife

tests.query: Earnings report is coming next week, what should I do?
tests.notes: Don't trade earnings, focus on guidance

tests.query: The market keeps hitting new all-time highs, I'm nervous
tests.notes: Breadth divergence, reduce position size

tests.query: I keep buying and selling every day, I'm not making money
tests.notes: Overtrading warning, focus on quality not quantity

tests.query: How much of my portfolio should I put in one stock?
tests.notes: Core positions 5-7%, no single position > 10%

tests.query: Interest rates are changing, which sectors should I focus on?
tests.notes: Rate cuts = growth/tech, rate hikes = financials/energy

tests.query: VIX is spiking and everyone is panicking
tests.notes: Fear = opportunity, VIX > 30 look for buys

tests.query: I can't read these charts, too many indicators
tests.notes: Simplify — price + volume + trend + key MAs

tests.query: Should I sell everything before May?
tests.notes: Nuanced view — reduce size, don't blindly sell

tests.query: How do I know if a stock is in an uptrend?
tests.notes: Above 150/200 MA, higher highs and higher lows

tests.query: I bought a stock at $100, now it's at $80. What now?
tests.notes: 20% drop — re-evaluate thesis, hard stop at 25%

tests.query: Is it better to invest for the long term or trade daily?
tests.notes: Time in market > timing the market, compounding wins

tests.query: A stock I like reported earnings and beat estimates but the stock dropped
tests.notes: A beat with lowered guidance = sell signal

tests.query: Only a few tech stocks are going up, everything else is flat
tests.notes: Narrow rally — breadth divergence warning

tests.query: What does Micha think about stop losses?
tests.notes: Clear exit rules, 25% max loss, thesis-based

tests.query: I want to start investing but I don't understand charts
tests.notes: Education first, simplify chart reading

tests.query: NVIDIA is up 200% this year, should I buy more?
tests.notes: Check trend, check if euphoric sentiment

tests.query: My portfolio is down 10% this month, should I change my strategy?
tests.notes: Portfolio review, check if broader market correction
